I have owned and used dozens of higher-capacity battery packs over the years, but sometimes you just need something small to get you through a single day of heavy use. Think of it like a “top off.” If you are heading out for an afternoon away from the office or jumping on a flight, you do not always want to carry a heavy brick. The PISEN 5000mAh wireless power bank is a super lightweight magnetic charger that fits into a minimal everyday carry setup.

MagSafe Monday: Every Monday, Bradley Chambers looks at the latest and greatest in the MagSafe and wireless charging industry to help you get the most out of your Apple devices that support wireless charging.

Overall, biggest selling point of this PISEN battery is the size. It comes just under 1/3rd pound and is incredibly thin. You can easily snap it to the back of your iPhone and slide the whole thing into your front pocket without looking like you’re carrying a brick. I

Charging speeds and ports

While it has only a 5,000 mAh battery capacity, that is exactly what you want for a slimmer EDC MagSafe battery. It holds enough battery to top off your iPhone when you are running low late in the day. It supports MagSafe charging up to 15 watts, and if you need power in a hurry, you can use the USB-C port to get 20-watt wired fast charging. I’ve found the wired charging to be nice when it’s 90+ degrees outside as well. MagSafe charging generates more heat than cable charging, but this battery does a good job of protecting both the power bank and your iPhone from overheating during use

One nice feature is that you can charge two devices at the same time using both wired and wireless charging simultaneously (think iPhone and AirPods). . A built-in stand is quickly becoming a required feature for me on MagSafe batteries. The PISEN includes an integrated alloy stand that folds out to easily prop up your iPhone. This is fantastic for watching a movie (Widows Bay on Apple TV….) on a tray table during a flight or doing a Zoom call from a hotel room.

Wrap up on the PISEN 5000mAh power bank

If you want a lightweight EDC MagSafe battery pack that handles the basics perfectly, the PISEN 5000mAh wireless power bank is a solid pickup. It’s travel-safe, includes temperature control to keep your iPhone cool, and provides a kickstand for video watching. It trades large capacity for portability, which is often the exact trade-off you want for short trip

You can grab the PISEN 5000mAh wireless power bank on Amazon to help stay charged for summer travel.
